blocks.text: Atomic radius atom ki jasamat ka pemana hai: aapas mein bandhe do ek jaise atoms ke darmiyan fasle ka aadha. Yeh bond ki qism (covalent, dhaati ya van der Waals) ya atom ki halat se badal sakta hai; covalent bond mein radius ionic bond se mukhtalif hota hai. Yeh picometres (pm) ya angstroms mein napa jata hai.

blocks.alt: Atoms golon ki shakal mein, apne radius ke mutabiq chhote bare: purane groups 1 se 8 baen se daen aur periods 1 se 6 oopar se neeche: H aur He; Li se Ne; Na se Ar; K, Ca aur Ga se Kr; Rb, Sr aur In se Xe; Cs, Ba aur Tl se Rn. Oopar ka teer 'atomic size decreases' (baen se daen) aur baen ka teer 'atomic size increases' (neeche ki taraf).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har gola ek atom hai aur us ka size atomic radius dikhata hai. Ek qataar (period) mein baen se daen gole chhote hote jate hain, kyunke nuclear charge barhta hai aur electrons qareeb kheenche jate hain. Ek column (group) mein neeche gole bare hote jate hain, kyunke har qadam par naya shell jurta hai. Kitab ki figure mein kuch symbols galat chhape hain: H ki jagah '11', Cl ki jagah 'Ci', Ge ki jagah 'Gc', Se ki jagah 'Sc', In ki jagah 'ln', Te ki jagah 'Tc', Xe ki jagah 'Xc' aur Po ki jagah 'Pa'. Yahan durust symbols likhe gaye hain.

Atomic radius par asar dalne wale awamil atomic number, moassar (effective) nuclear charge aur andarooni electrons ka shielding effect hain. Aam taur par atomic radius period mein baen se daen ghat'ta hai, kyunke barhta nuclear charge electron cloud ko qareeb kheenchta hai. Is ke bar-aks yeh group mein neeche barhta hai, kyunke izafi electron shells jurte hain aur zyada shielding atom ko bara banati hai agarche nuclear charge bhi barhta hai, jo ghalib nahin aata.

blocks.prompt: Sodium ka atom magnesium ke atom se bara kyun hai, phir bhi potassium ke atom se chhota?
blocks.explanation: Magnesium usi period mein sodium ke baad aata hai: ek zyada proton usi bairooni shell ko qareeb kheenchta hai, to magnesium chhota hai. Potassium usi group mein sodium ke neeche hai: us ka ek izafi shell hai, aur andarooni electrons ki shielding us ke zyada nuclear charge par ghalib hai, to potassium bara hai.

items: Atomic radius: bandhe do ek jaise atoms ke fasle ka aadha, pm ya angstroms mein; bond ki qism aur atom ki halat par munhasir.
Atomic number, moassar nuclear charge aur shielding se tai: period mein chhota (zyada nuclear charge, wohi shell), group mein neeche bara (zyada shells, zyada shielding).
